title: DevHub
summary: Exploited an RCE in MCPJam (CVE-2026-23744) for initial access, performed lateral movement by extracting a Jupyter Lab token from procfs and tunneling via SSH, and escalated to root by extracting hardcoded credentials to abuse a hidden endpoint in an internal Flask API.

title: Reactor
summary: Gained initial access by exploiting a React/Next.js command execution flaw, retrieved credentials from an internal SQLite database, and escalated to root through an exposed Node.js inspector debugger session.

title: AirTouch
summary: Compromised a multi-tier wireless environment by exploiting SNMP info leakage, pivoting through a WPA2-PSK network to a router, and executing Evil Twin attack against WPA2-Enterprise to capture administrative creds.

title: Environment
summary: Laravel application with login bypass, file upload vulnerability, and privilege escalation via BASH_ENV exploitation.

title: Editor
summary: XWiki 15.10.8 vulnerable to RCE (CVE-2025-24893) with subsequent privilege escalation via Netdata SUID binaries, resulting in full system compromise.

title: Soulmate
summary: Exploited a CrushFTP authentication bypass vulnerability (CVE-2025-31161) to gain initial access, then used an exposed internal Erlang service to escalate privileges to root.

title: Puppy
summary: Compromised an Active Directory domain controller by exploiting weak secrets management, abusing overly permissive ACLs, and leveraging DPAPI to recover high-privilege credentials, culminating in a full domain compromise via a DCSync attack.

title: DarkZero
summary: Compromised a Windows domain by pivoting through MSSQL Linked Servers, escalating to SYSTEM via a Kernel race condition (CVE-2024-30088), and performing a cross-domain DCSync attack by coercing authentication to capture a TGT.

title: Touch
summary: Escalated a Windows kiosk appliance from an unauthenticated device-serial leak used as the default web-console password to RDP access as KioskUser, then hunted a cleartext MySQL root password in a readable maintenance batch file and abused a writable MySQL plugin directory to load a UDF DLL, executing commands as SYSTEM.

title: Autopilot
summary: Chained a Nextcloud WebDAV upload with the exposed data directory to execute code as grofiles, pivoted through the gromox FPM socket and MySQL to the grommunio admin API, abused a Postfix dbconf hook for Linux root, then relayed WS02's recurring IMAP NTLM authentication to its unsigned SMB, recovered Stephanie's saved Thunderbird login, reversed the XOR in runas.exe for Domain Admin, and read the DC root flag.

title: DutyBound
summary: Used a valid IATA BCBP to reach the AirSnacks audit logger, injected a stacked query through the airline-use field, abused the database role's COPY ... TO PROGRAM capability for postgres command execution, pivoted through X11 to dutyfree-kiosk, and turned a writable duty-rate CSV into root via a systemd eval.

title: Stream
summary: Recovered ClickHouse service credentials from an exposed Spring Boot heap dump, used an AIDX XXE to read files as svc-infra, pivoted through Kafka SASL and a bcrypt identity record to martin_cole, then leaked the ClickHouse default password from a Kopia-restored error log and abused a root DLQ timer that executes a ClickHouse user_files formatter to obtain root.

title: Layover
summary: Captured a staff member's cleartext Miles login on open airport Wi-Fi, reused it against Craft CMS, chained an authenticated element-search behavior injection to read the application secrets and decrypt the mail-relay credential, then pivoted to aporter and rooted the portal through a CUPS 2.4.16 local token leak.

title: Unclaimed
summary: Leaked TracerBot's hidden support override through prompt injection, used it to run arbitrary SQL, impersonated a sysadmin SQL login to enable xp_cmdshell, decrypted a SQL Agent proxy credential by fixing the LEN()/DATALENGTH() truncation, and abused Backup Operators' SeBackupPrivilege over WinRM to read the Administrator root flag.
